rows.text: The complete browser run recorded a menu timing failure: the test sampled Move to Backlog before the anchored surface became visible and skipped the action. Exact before evidence is preserved in .harness/migration-round2-menu-before; only returnDestination and returnPersisted differ.

The independent inspection reviewer confirmed the menu is deliberately positioned asynchronously. Added a strict visible-menu assertion before reading it; no production code or expected result changed. Focused and complete browser verification are pending.
